style: v7.8 — the eighteen-year-old back in Aaron (B6uUx2p7cRgxseOUyP6P, eleven_v3), Chad's fallback after Gabriel ('Either find a better one, or stick to the same voice we used back in ep 1'). The v5.28 prompt rules: the registry's words EXACTLY, no capitals added, at most one tag and it names an EMOTION (a whisper carries a feeling with it), at most one added ellipsis, never prose in brackets. Two takes each on flow bvCh0Bu0vPMwM7w91RGM; the take per line chosen by the v7.1 measure (no spoken-tag segment, pace nearest 2.4 words a second).

prompts.n1pro1: [quiet, resigned] Eighteen. The ferry to Tekong at seven in the morning, and nobody on it talking.
prompts.n1pro2: [flat, tired] Hawk Company. Twenty of us to a bunk, two rows of double-deck beds, and the sergeant walking the line with a clipboard.
prompts.n1pro3: [wry, resigned] Bed one. Right next to the toilet door. The worst spot in the room, and the one nobody wanted.
prompts.n1pro4: [quiet, unconvinced] I told myself it didn't matter where you slept. Lights out was at ten.
prompts.n1voice: [tired, steeling himself] First day. Just get through it.
prompts.n1act: [uneasy whisper] Nobody else is moving. Nobody else can hear it?
prompts.n1fallin: [startled, urgent] That's the whistle. Go, go.
prompts.n1late: [sour, muttering] Twenty push-ups. On day one.
prompts.n1bedok: [relieved] Done. Pillow, blanket, boots, all of it.
prompts.n1bedfail: [deflated] Again. The whole bunk, because of me.
prompts.n1shower: [calm, matter-of-fact] Just a shower block. Tiles, a drain, a timer tap.
prompts.n1hear: [uneasy whisper] The shower. Somebody's in the shower. At three in the morning.
prompts.n1A1: [unnerved whisper] Nobody. The water's running and there's nobody.
prompts.n1A2: [shaken whisper] ...there was someone at the end of the corridor.
prompts.n1B1: [tense whisper] Just listen. Don't decide what it is. Just listen.
prompts.n1D1: [frightened whisper] It's nothing. It's nothing. It's nothing.
prompts.n1A: [quiet, reflective] I got up and looked. I found water, and nothing else, and a corridor I did not like.
prompts.n1B: [quiet, reflective] I stayed still and listened. What I heard was a sound. What it meant, I did not know yet.
prompts.n1C: [quiet, reflective] I asked the one person who could tell me. He heard nothing. That was worth knowing.
prompts.n1D: [quiet, ashamed] I decided what it was before I knew anything. Under the blanket, the water kept running.
